templateOwned.description: Files 100% owned by the template — overwritten on update. A file whose content differs from the checksum recorded at install/update time (.claude/template-checksums) is a local edit: update.sh backs it up to .claude/.update-backup/<from>-to-<to>-<timestamp>/ before overwriting. Forge ships its own scripts and hooks only under scripts/forge/ and .claude/hooks/forge/; everything else under scripts/ and .claude/hooks/ belongs to the project.

templateDerived.description: Template files whose changes should propagate to generated files in target projects. Only updates files that already exist in the target (i.e., agents the project chose to install). Placeholder variables are substituted using .claude/project-config.json.

mappings.description: Agent templates → generated agents. Three-way merge preserves all project customizations.
CLAUDE.md template → project CLAUDE.md. Three-way merge preserves project overview, architecture, custom sections.

mergeFiles.description: Files with both template and project content — smart merge required

.mcp.json.description: Union of mcpServers keys — add new template servers, keep existing project servers

.gitignore.description: Add new template lines, keep existing project lines

hookFragments.description: Forge hook entries merged into the project's .claude/settings.json. On every update, every hook entry whose command contains ownedPrefix is removed (a matcher group left empty is removed too) and the fragment's groups are appended; all other entries, including non-command hooks that share a group with a Forge hook, stay untouched. Skipped when settings.json does not exist yet (/setup-wizard does the first merge).

templateRepoOnly.description: Files that exist only in the template repo — NOT copied to target projects during install or update

copyIfMissing.description: Files copied only if they don't exist in the target project; once copied they belong to the project
